main.summary: Internal issued access-key material produced after successful issuance and membership-state updates but before concrete key-instance construction.

property.name: Assertions
property.summary: Generated access-key assertions associated with the approved issuance flow.

property.name: Ciphertext
property.summary: Encrypted access-key payload used to construct the concrete key instance.

property.name: CacheKey
property.summary: Derived membership-cache identity for the issued ciphertext envelope when it could be created; otherwise null.

property.name: Membership
property.summary: Resolved membership metadata when it could be reconstructed from the issued ciphertext; otherwise null.
